newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil spuds dry well in Norwegian Sea.
newsitem.headline: Statoil spuds dry well in Norwegian Sea.

text.p: The Norwegian Oil Directorate (OD) said on Monday that Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) had drilled a dry exploration well in the Nordland II area of the Norwegian Sea.
Statoil, as operator, controls 50 percent of licence 159 in block 6507/3, and is partnered by Norske Hydro ASA and Total Norge AS both with 20 percent and Saga Petroleum ASA with 10 percent.
Exploration well 6507/3-2 was drilled to a depth of 2,008 metres below sea level and was permanently plugged.
The first well was spudded in the northern end of the block in 1990 and found gas, the OD said in a statement.
